archetypes.name: dyn-invariant-grammar
archetypes.rationale: Changed invariant ID grammar should be checked for parser drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the invariant ID grammar change in learn_from_bugs and its regression coverage. Verify canonical I-* headings still index and read, while INV-* headings no longer create false coverage. Check that the test compares public parser surfaces without overfitting private regex constants. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
